script_text: Pisces, this week the cosmos drags you into a swirling vortex of change. On Monday, Mars in your 3rd House squares Neptune, creating tense communication currents. Tuesday brings a sextile from Venus in your 7th House to Jupiter, offering a brief romantic lift. The water element guides your intuition gently each day. Midweek, the Sun in Leo forms a trine to your ruling planet Neptune, igniting a surge of intuitive clarity. Thursday sees Saturn in your 10th House square Mercury, testing your professional resolve. By Sunday, a harmonious sextile between Mars and Jupiter in your 9th House promises adventurous expansion. Wednesday is your power day because Venus enters your 5th House, amplifying love and creativity. Monday is your worst day as Mars squares Saturn in your 7th House, straining relationships. Embrace the water element's flow and journal your insights each morning. Follow for daily updates.
